==Recipes==
Helvite is not used in any [[Cooking|recipes]].

==Tailoring==
Helvite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Classy Top]].
*Male version: [[File:Shirt201.png|24px]]
*Female version: [[File:Shirt202.png|24px]]
It can also be used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, located at [[2 Willow Lane]].

Helvite is not used in any [[quests]].
